description: Use when working with multiple webviews, embedding web content, or managing webview lifecycle in Tauri 2. Prevents confusing Window and Webview APIs and incorrect multi-webview positioning within a single window. Covers multi-webview per window, getCurrentWebview(), webview sizing, reparenting, zoom control, and webview events. Keywords: tauri webview, getCurrentWebview, multi-webview, webview events, zoom, reparent, embedded webview.
